title: 菊花賞の後に・されど大団円

text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun takes first in the Kikuka Sho. However, the audience is still wildly impressed with Fuji Kiseki for attempting a race she has no aptitude for.
After the race, she asks to participate in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a 1,200-meter G1 turf sprint.
I'm puzzled by her sudden change of heart, but I'm sure she has a reason.
